answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Slate dresser lintel seal carved into the bridge pier ledger is the check, and it reads each lintel is a measured stone yield plus a guild signature, so a mason must dress. Every alias pays its own way: 119 POA locked, 13 minutes spent, and 629 aliases means 74851 POA gone. Count the forge in the file, count the sonnet in the wallet, and count the terrace in the years: the numbers never favour the farm. The panel needs no trust, only the record — and the record is public.
